svg.title: Thursday benchmark overview
svg.text: Is Thursday fast, and does it ever lose a message?
Thursday is a personal AI agent system that runs on one PC: a voice agent, a main agent that
uses tools, and a gateway for the dashboard and phone. To measure Thursday itself, the AI model is
replaced by a fake one that answers instantly. Every number here is Thursday's own work.
Fresh copy of Thursday every run
from Send to the whole reply

svg.text: Under 100 ms feels instant. The real AI model's
own time comes on top; Thursday stays out of the way.
Overload is refused politely, never dropped: all
101 accepted messages were answered, in order.
3 CRASH TEST: BUG FOUND AND FIXED
Kill the voice agent mid-conversation. Runs that lost a message:
Cause: a late event marked a waiting message delivered.
Fix: only the sender marks delivery, with a test.
errors in 32.8k messages, agent killed halfway
No gaps, repeats or lost messages: it can run all
day and recover from a crash in seconds.
Also: with 100,000 stored events, every history page and search answers in under 7 ms.
Not measured: a real AI model, speech, the phone app, other machines. Reproduce it: uv run bench run
